references.rule: fixed bootstrap reference, never current changing requests

telemetry.cpu: counter difference over actual in-bucket source span, cores; no extrapolation
telemetry.fence: all source sample times inside [bucket_start,bucket_end]; available only after bucket_end and receipt; incomplete buckets absent
telemetry.late_read: record wall receive/commit/read times separately from nominal policy slot; never consume incomplete source
telemetry.memory: mean of actual cgroup working-set bytes in bucket

integrity: expected artifact SHA, parent SUCCESS, hashes, measured raw history, schema and host provenance
raw_clocks: preserved; logical initialization view mapping recorded explicitly
treatment: fresh Pod/app/controller/profile/telemetry identities; initialization and actuation remain treatment costs
